blocks.text: Which card should I pay with?
Cashback SBI Card earns the same now; its 5% on online payments covers more of your spending, so keep it free for later.

items.meta: 5% on Amazon, Swiggy, Zomato and 7 more

msgs.what: This user holds HDFC Millennia and SBI Cashback. Both pay 5% here.
Millennia's 5% covers 10 named merchants; SBI Cashback's 5% covers every online payment, capped at ₹2,000 a statement cycle.

msgs.l: rest of month after each choice
msgs.what: Monthly spends prorated to the days left, routed under the caps and credit left after paying with Millennia, then with SBI Cashback.
msgs.code:

msgs.what: When your other online spends fill SBI's cap, ₹60 used on Swiggy is ₹60 they can't earn. If the cap never fills, both futures are equal…
…and the tie goes to the card whose rule is narrower (named merchants beat 'all online'), keeping the broad cap free. Same answer whatever order the cards were added in.
